One neutral model scored on vertebrate Cytb and ND2, the human megatree, cancer and GTEx mtDNA, and MitoMap. The y-axis is the centered-log-ratio Pearson correlation (`pearson_corr_clr`). Mammal Cytb/ND1 tables are not in `data/external`, and the vertebrate spectrum file has no 12-class ND1 row, so those comparisons are absent from this figure.

Hover a point for the dataset name, R², Spearman correlation, and the number of substitution types.
